summary: Preparing concise bilingual Markdown pre-class guides for two user-uploaded Kyna English PDFs: Speaking Practice 'What I eat in a day' (5 pages, 20 open speaking prompts) and Beginner 1A Business English 'Would you like some soup? Part 1' (14 pages, food vocabulary, offers, countability, some/any). Will cover original exercises and supplemental speaking patterns, noting source gaps.
